title: Skip button missing on last set and second-to-last rest
description: The Skip button doesn't appear on the rest period before the last set of an exercise, which means you can't skip into the last set. Also doesn't appear on the last set itself. Should be available on every set and every rest period.
close_reason: Show skip button on all sets and rest periods (except last exercise)

title: Custom rest timer ignored - always defaults to 1:30
description: When setting a custom rest period (something other than 1:30) on an exercise, the rest timer still shows 1:30 between sets. The per-exercise rest_seconds value isn't being picked up by the active workout timer.
close_reason: Added rest_seconds to insert payloads in createTemplate and updateTemplate

title: Hide top nav menu during active workout
description: The Dashboard/Templates/Schedule nav tabs and sign out button remain visible during an active workout. Hide them while in workout mode since the user won't navigate during exercise. Show just the workout header bar (Cancel, progress, elapsed time).
close_reason: Added WorkoutModeContext to hide Layout header during active workout

title: Workout name truncated behind Start Workout button
description: On the Today's Workout card, the workout name (e.g. WEDNESDAY - ...) gets cut off behind the Start Workout button. Rearrange the layout so the full name is visible - consider stacking the button below the title or giving the title its own full-width row.
close_reason: Moved title to full-width row, button and exercise count on second row

title: Dashboard this-week volume doesn't update after workout completes
description: After finishing a workout, the This Week volume number on the dashboard doesn't automatically refresh. User has to reload the page to see the updated count.

title: Rest screen header text too small
description: The REST label on the rest timer screen is undersized relative to the countdown digits. Make it more prominent so the screen reads clearly at a glance from across the room.
close_reason: Bumped REST header from text-3xl to text-5xl with uppercase tracking-widest

title: Add Ignition set + effective reps exercise type
description: New exercise modality: Ignition sets with effective reps. Workflow: do a 12-rep ignition set at a weight where you'd fail at 12-14 reps. Take a 30-second rest, then grind out 20 additional effective reps in as many mini-sets as needed with 15-30 seconds between each. Then 3-minute rest before the next exercise. Needs schema changes (new exercise type or mode flag), template/schedule support, and active workout UI that guides the user through the ignition set -> short rests -> effective reps flow with rep counting.

title: Dashboard completed workout should show adjusted weights/reps
description: When a workout is completed and the user adjusted weights or reps during the session, the dashboard summary should reflect the actual logged values rather than the originally scheduled targets.
